items.information:
## Português

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 70 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 70 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

items.information:
Bem-vindos ao primeiro campeonato sediado em Morro Reuter !

🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competidores participando pela primeira vez são obrigados a apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, gênero, data de nascimento e nacionalidade.

Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral).

---

🇺🇸 Welcome to the first competition in Morro Reuter!

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorroReuterCubing2023/register). If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cJNjPk_J4M).

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, gender, date of birth and nationality.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will consider the final ranking).

items.name: La Tienda Cubera Fest 2023
items.information:
### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023#30447-registro-register) para conocer los medios de pago.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023/register)
* **Los acompañantes de los competidores tendrán que pagar s/10 el dia del torneo para poder acceder a las instalaciones**
 
### **IMPORTANT**
  You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.
	
*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023#30447-registro-register) to know the payment methods.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaTiendaCuberaFest2023/register)
*  **Competitors' companions will have to pay s/10 on the day of the competition to have access to the venue**

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/134067997901/) , follow our [Instagram Account](https://www.instagram.com/utahcubing/?igshid=YmMyMTA2M2Y%3D&fbclid=IwAR1cR0LkqGd_shYd3O3iJQ25r9kpW9YG1WiH4YDUYR1isrPfgLUt9cWWGOY), join the [Rockies discord server](https://discord.com/invite/vhqaSvqqmM?fbclid=IwAR3YbxFyHh4Y8-7CZE1HH2W4T2Zm6RbmMDILisohZUr3AO08hEvPtMskN0Q), and check out the [Utah Cubing website](https://utahcubing.com/) to be notified when local competitions are announced, and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
